clue.text: Crow and lark's head covered in butter

indicators.note: the first letter of lark is wrapped by the butting animal's name

parts.note: a goat is an animal that butts, hence a butter

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A bird and a lark's head smothered in butter, like a kitchen accident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'butter' reads as the dairy spread but is one who butts, a GOAT; 'covered in' puts L (the head of lark) inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To crow is to boast triumphantly, the same as gloating over a win.

clue.text: Dame Edna supports learner making purchase

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece placed beneath holds up the other, so the learner's letter comes on top

parts.note: L is the learner-driver plate abbreviation
Dame Edna Everage was Barry Humphries's comic character

explanation.surface: The comedian Dame Edna backs a learner who is buying something.
explanation.walkthrough: Dame Edna Everage was an Australian drag persona played by Barry Humphries. In a down entry, 'supports' puts EVERAGE under L.
explanation.definitionFit: Purchase means grip or mechanical advantage, which is what leverage gives.

clue.text: 100 yobs coming to blows

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
yobs and louts are both rowdy young men

explanation.surface: A hundred hooligans start fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: Clouts are heavy hits, so the plural noun matches blows.

clue.text: Swell to fortissimo

parts.note: ff is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: A musical instruction to swell up to very loud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swell' looks like a musical crescendo but is the noun for a smart, upper-class person.
explanation.definitionFit: A swell is a fashionable gentleman, and a toff is a posh, well-dressed person.

clue.text: Relative in north-east: that's a relief

parts.note: NE is the compass abbreviation
phew is the exclamation of relief

explanation.surface: Someone sighs with relief that a family member lives in the north-east.
explanation.definitionFit: A nephew is a brother's or sister's son, a family member.

clue.text: Beaten Arabs lost an impressive winger

indicators.note: beaten here means knocked about, so the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Defeated Arabs lose a remarkable wide player on their football team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winger' suggests a footballer but means a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The albatross has the largest wingspan of any bird, so it is an impressive flier.

clue.text: Sporty student to initiate classy descent

parts.note: a Blue is an Oxford or Cambridge student who has represented the university at sport
to blood someone is to give them a first taste of an activity

explanation.surface: A sporting student begins a stylish downhill run.
explanation.walkthrough: A Blue is an award to an Oxford or Cambridge student for representing the university at sport. 'descent' suggests going downhill but means ancestry.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue blood means aristocratic ancestry, so noble lineage fits a classy descent.

clue.text: Born in Paris she is lovely woman

parts.note: elle is French for she

explanation.surface: She was born in Paris and is a beautiful woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A belle is a beautiful woman, especially the most admired at a gathering.

clue.text: Sheep from Ireland doctor keeps

indicators.note: the doctor's letters hold the name of Ireland inside them

parts.note: MO is a medical officer
Erin is the poetic name for Ireland

explanation.surface: An Irish sheep looked after by a vet.
explanation.definitionFit: Merino is a breed of sheep prized for its fine wool.

clue.text: Rich cake and drink found in Gaul, mostly

indicators.note: the drink sits inside what is left of the ancient country name
mostly means all but the final letter of Gaul

parts.note: tea is the drink

explanation.surface: Fancy cake and a drink discovered in ancient Gaul.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts Gaul to GAU; 'found in' puts TEA inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A gateau is a rich, often layered cream cake of French origin.

clue.text: First-year student cheeky in front of staff

indicators.note: the word for cheeky is placed before the verb for staff

parts.note: fresh can mean impudent or cheeky
to staff a post is to man it

explanation.surface: A new student is rude to the teachers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staff' looks like a noun (the teachers) but is the verb man.
explanation.definitionFit: In American colleges a freshman is a student in the first year.

clue.text: Old girl distributed medals

indicators.note: distributed means handed out in different directions, so the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A former pupil handed out the prizes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old girl' suggests a former pupil but means a young woman of old.
explanation.definitionFit: Damsel is an archaic word for a young unmarried woman.

clue.text: The writer is drunk outside — over this perhaps?

indicators.note: the drunk word goes around the contracted setter's phrase

parts.note: lit is slang for drunk
the writer refers to the setter, so 'the writer is' becomes I'm

explanation.surface: The setter is tipsy and suspects being over the drink-drive threshold.
explanation.walkthrough: The writer is = I'M, the setter speaking. The definition ties back to the surface: a drunk is over the limit.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has drunk too much is said to be over the legal threshold, the limit.

clue.text: During hostilities Democrat reveals secret

parts.note: in can mean during, as in 'in winter'
hostilities means war
D is the abbreviation for a US Democrat

explanation.surface: In wartime a politician lets slip classified information.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reveals' is a link word meaning the pieces show the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Inward thoughts are private ones, hidden within, hence secret.

clue.text: Supreme soldier often up on horse

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the next piece

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper, a soldier who often goes up in the air before jumping
a mount is a horse for riding

explanation.surface: A top-ranking soldier frequently climbs onto his horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Paramount means supreme or of the highest importance.

clue.text: Northern valley supplied at last with beer

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of supplied

parts.note: ale is a beer

explanation.surface: A valley in the North finally gets its beer delivered.
explanation.definitionFit: Dale is the word used for a valley in northern England, as in the Yorkshire Dales.

clue.text: Bishop in posh car West Indian moves?

indicators.note: the bishop's letter is placed inside the posh car

parts.note: a limo is a luxury car
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A bishop in a limousine dances like a Caribbean.
explanation.definitionFit: The limbo is a Caribbean dance in which performers bend backwards under a low bar.

clue.text: Young family makes mess

definitions.meaning: a set of animals born together, such as puppies

explanation.surface: Having young children creates chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a brood of newborn animals and rubbish strewn untidily.

clue.text: Dance venue wanting backer in circle

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, and the backer is the rear letter, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a disco is a dance club

explanation.surface: A club lacks a financial supporter within its social circle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backer' suggests an investor but means the back letter, O.
explanation.definitionFit: A disc is a flat round shape, a circle.

clue.text: Cross having endless pain in face

indicators.note: the shortened word for pain goes inside the clock face

parts.note: a dial is the face of a clock

indicators.note: endless means losing the final letter

parts.note: agony is severe pain

explanation.surface: Someone angry with agony showing in their face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like the adjective for angry, but here it means slanting, running from corner to corner.
explanation.definitionFit: Diagonal and cross both describe a line running slantwise across something.

clue.text: Giselle perhaps takes everyone in punt

indicators.note: the gamble word takes in the word for everyone

parts.note: a punt is a gamble or bet
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A woman named Giselle carries everyone in a flat-bottomed boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'punt' suggests the river boat but means a wager.
explanation.definitionFit: Giselle is a famous Romantic ballet, an example of the art form.

clue.text: Bark's courageous owner sails absurdly close to shore

indicators.note: absurdly means in a crazy way, so the letters are jumbled
close to here means the closing letter of shore

explanation.surface: A brave boat-owner sails wildly near the coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'absurdly' rearranges SAILS to LASSI; 'close to' gives E, the end of shore. 'Bark' suggests a sailing ship but is a dog's bark.
explanation.definitionFit: Lassie is the brave collie of film and TV, so the bark belongs to her.

clue.text: Sailor repeatedly sees fierce person

indicators.note: repeatedly means the sailor word is written twice

parts.note: a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor keeps seeing a violent person.
explanation.definitionFit: A tartar is a person who is violent-tempered or formidable.

clue.text: Finish work and go to bed

definitions.meaning: to stop working for good at the end of a career
to turn in for the night

explanation.surface: Stop working and head off to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to leave employment for good and to turn in for the night.

clue.text: Composer keeping time in group

indicators.note: the composer's name keeps the time letter inside it

parts.note: J S Bach was a composer

explanation.surface: A composer keeps the beat in a band.
explanation.definitionFit: A batch is a set or group of things dealt with together.

clue.text: He has dog rolling big barrel

indicators.note: rolling means turning over and over, so the letters are tumbled

explanation.surface: A man's dog is rolling a large cask.
explanation.definitionFit: A hogshead is a large cask, traditionally holding about 54 gallons.

clue.text: Pain in the neck? Medic rang regularly

parts.note: Dr is the abbreviation for doctor

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of rang

explanation.surface: A patient with a stiff neck phones the doctor often.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the alternate letters A and G of rang.
explanation.definitionFit: A drag is a tiresome nuisance, which is what a pain in the neck means.

clue.text: God needs a mark to locate treasure chest

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder
on a treasure map X marks the spot

explanation.surface: A deity needs a map mark to find a treasure chest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treasure chest' reads as one thing, but 'chest' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The thorax is the part of the body between neck and abdomen, the chest.

clue.text: Bone discovered in Roman villa

indicators.note: discovered in means the letters are found within the words Roman villa

explanation.surface: An archaeologist unearths a bone at a Roman villa.
explanation.definitionFit: The anvil, or incus, is one of the small bones of the middle ear.

clue.text: Protest about short audition for leading lady

indicators.note: the protest word goes about the shortened audition word

parts.note: a march is a protest demonstration

indicators.note: short means missing its final letter

parts.note: a trial is a test such as an audition

explanation.surface: Demonstrating against a curtailed audition for the main actress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leading lady' suggests a star actress, but here it means the woman at the head of a family.
explanation.definitionFit: A matriarch is the woman who heads a family or group.
